name: The Lost Hills
description: Hills lost in mist. Five steps up lead to the top; any step aside lets the mist turn you round.

h0.name: The Foot of the Hills
h0.description: Low hills in a thick, wet mist. Every way looks the same as every other, and the ground is soft underfoot.

h1.name: Lost in the Hills
h1.description: The mist is so thick that you cannot see your own hands. Somewhere above you the ground rises.

h5.name: The Hilltop
h5.description: The mist thins at last. A low, round door stands in the hillside, with a lizard carved over it.
